biography:
As a Senior Real Estate Development at Amazon Web Services (AWS), I lead the land use permitting process for new data center regions across the globe. I leverage my legal, regulatory, and planning expertise to navigate complex and ambiguous challenges, negotiate with stakeholders, ensure compliance, and deliver optimal outcomes for AWS, communities and its customers.

I have over seven years of experience in real estate development, zoning, and site acquisition, working with various public and private entities. I am a certified planner (AICP) and a licensed attorney in Illinois and Washington. I am passionate about urban planning and policy, and I have contributed to the professional and academic communities through leadership roles, publications, and awards. I am driven by the mission of AWS to innovate and provide scalable, reliable, and secure cloud services to the world.
